scope: BoughtShift, DangerLeafBought, DangerLeafPrice and MegaShop_AfterPurchase in src/mega_shop.c
finding: ITEM_MILD inherited the leaf purchase counter and escalated despite not being a counted item.
fix: Return the base price for items other than ITEM_DANGER_LEAF and ITEM_DANGER_SUGAR.
coverage: Every u16 saved value and each of the three shop items; independent capped-price oracle, invalid-tag reset, counter saturation, preservation of the other counter, unchanged unrelated item, closed-shop no-op.
limitations: Native execution of extracted production functions with mocked save access and shop-open state; purchase hooks, linked ROM and GBA runtime remain unverified.
